oneLine: Watches forward pick faces against a min/max rule and asks for stock to be moved from the fullest reserve bin, then closes the request when the move is recorded.

rows.title: Declare a min/max rule for a pick face
rows.story: A planner sets the minimum, maximum and case multiple for one SKU at one site. Changing a rule needs the version the planner last saw.

rows.title: Ask for stock when a face runs low
rows.story: inventory-storage reports a new bin level. If the pick face of that SKU is now at or below its minimum, a request is raised to move stock from the fullest reserve bin.
rows.policy: Whenever a bin level changes, keep it and re-check that SKU's pick face

then.does: plans one REPLENISH work unit for the request

rows.title: Close the request when the stock has moved
rows.story: inventory-storage records a relocation tagged as replenishment. If it matches an open request, the request is completed with the quantity actually moved.
rows.policy: Whenever a replenishment move is recorded for an open request, complete that request

rows.title: Check a whole site by hand
rows.story: A planner re-runs detection for every pick face of a site. Faces that already have an open request are left alone, so running it twice raises nothing new.

then.does: plans one REPLENISH work unit for the request

rows.title: Ask for a replenishment by hand
rows.story: A planner raises a request for one SKU, optionally with a quantity. It is refused if there is no pick face, no rule or no source stock, or if a request is already open.

then.does: plans one REPLENISH work unit for the request

rows.title: Follow the case size from product-master
rows.story: A rule can take its multiple from the SKU's case size instead of a typed number. When the case size changes, such rules get a new multiple. A retired case size flags them stale.
rows.policy: Whenever a case size is declared, keep it and re-derive the multiple of rules that follow it

rows.title: Follow the approved slot plan
rows.story: slotting-optimization approves a new forward map. Requests whose face no longer holds that SKU are cancelled, and new or moved faces are checked for stock.
rows.policy: Whenever a newer slot plan is approved, replace the forward map and cancel requests it drops

then.does: withdraws REPLENISH work that is still pending
plans one REPLENISH work unit for the request

rows.title: Keep the layout copy
rows.story: facility-layout announces zones and locations, and later retires some. Here a copy tells which bins are pick faces and which are reserve bins.
rows.policy: Whenever a zone or location is registered or decommissioned, update the layout copy

rows.title: Cancel a request
rows.story: A planner cancels a request that is still open. A completed or cancelled request is final and cannot be cancelled again.

then.does: withdraws REPLENISH work that is still pending

rows.title: Remove a rule and its open requests
rows.story: A planner removes the rule of a SKU. In the same step every open request for that SKU at the site is cancelled.

then.does: withdraws REPLENISH work that is still pending

hotspots.text: A bin never seen reads as level 0, so a face whose level has not arrived yet can get an unnecessary URGENT request.
Requests only become floor work if wes-work-planning opts in and the REPLENISH path is seeded; cluster state was not checked.
A partial fill leaves the face below its maximum. The next detection raises a fresh request once the first is closed.
Until a bin changes, its stock level is unknown because inventory-storage has no backfill. Detection then finds no source bin.

opportunities.text: A demand-cover rule (days of cover from demand) is planned as a later policy kind behind the same shape as min/max.
Velocity-derived min/max, multi-SKU faces, reserve-to-reserve consolidation and travel-aware source choice are listed for later ADRs.
